title: App tile mark spin-resolve sting
summary: A black rounded app tile fades in over a soft iridescent gradient, its white line mark spins out of a blur into focus, holds, then dissolves back and the tile shrinks away. A 3 s silent loop for an icon moment.
use_when: A short logo sting or loop for an app whose icon is a single-colour mark on a solid tile
Opening or closing a longer film on the app icon
A silent social or website loop that returns to the empty background
An AI or abstract product whose mark reads as a knot, swirl or radial glyph

look.type_style: no type; white line mark at ~45 % of the tile width, tile ~42 % of frame height with ~22 % corner radius

sfx.event: mark spins out of the blur into focus

structure.shot: empty iridescent gradient; black rounded app tile centred; white line mark resolves, holds, leaves; tile shrinks out
structure.camera: static (motion.json pan 0-1 px/s, zoom 0.0 %/s; background does not move)
structure.motion: f0-3 empty; tile opacity 0->1 f4-9 (6 fr, easings.outQuint), no scale change; mark f10-24: blur ~0.1 tile -> 0, rotation in (amount not measurable), opacity 0->1, easings.outExpo 15 fr; hold f24-78; mark exit f79-83 reverse (blur up, dim, 5 fr, easings.inExpo); tile f84-89 opacity 1->0, scale 1.0->0.6, easings.inExpo 6 fr; f90-95 empty

params.brand: any brand.json: tile colour (fg or a dark surface), mark colour, gradient colours for the backdrop
params.content.mark: single-colour SVG mark, line or solid, centred in the tile
params.content.tileRadius: corner radius as a share of tile size (default 0.22)
params.background: gradient image or generated mesh-gradient stops (3-5 pastel colours)
params.loop: true = start and end on the empty background (default)

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips at t = 0 and t = 2.2: tile in f4-9, mark resolve f10-24, hold to f78, mark out f79-83, tile out with shrink f84-89, empty from f90. Exit is faster than entrance (5+6 fr vs 6+15 fr). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): spin-resolve (mark spins out of a gaussian blur into focus), tile-pop-out (container shrinks and fades after its content leaves). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is silent.
